simple.summary: זָנָב (zânâb) means the tail (literally or figuratively) First listed occurrence: Deut 28 13.

definitions.full: H2180. zanab זָנָב noun masculine Judg 15:4 tail , also (figurative) end, stump (Late Hebrew id. , Assyrian zibbatu Hom NS 368 , Ethiopic Arabic , Aramaic , דַּנְבָּא דּוּנְבָּא, ) — ׳ז absolute 15:4 (twice in verse) + 5 t.; suffix זְנָבוֺ Job 40:17 ; plural זְנָבוֺת Judg 15:4 ; construct זַנְבוֺת Isa 7:4 ; — 1. a. tail of fox Judg 15:4 (3 t. in verse), of serpent Exod 4:4 (J), of hippopotamus Job 40:17 ; b. figurative of common people, opposed to rulers Isa 9:13 ; 19:15 (in both, וְזָנָב ראֹשׁ , || וְאַגְמוֺן כִּמָּה ; 9:14 is incorrect gloss); of subject-people (opposed to ראֹשׁ ) Deut 28:13 , 44 . 2 end, stump (of firebrand, אוּד ) in metaphor Isa 7:4 .
definitions.rootNote: from 2179 (in the original sense of flapping );
